visual_text: Illustrative example of a written plan
A DNACPR decision is about CPR
DNACPR means 'do not attempt cardiopulmonary resuscitation'. UK guidance: every other treatment and all care is still offered on its merits.
Calls for senior help if unwell
Ask: what will still be done?
Perkins et al., NIHR HS&DR 2016; Moffat et al., J Eval Clin Pract 2016
alt_text: Two-column card. A narrow left column headed Not recommended shows a crossed circle beside CPR. A wider right column headed Still offered on its merits lists seven items with tick icons: regular checks, calls for senior help if unwell, pain and symptom relief, food and drink, other treatments, rehabilitation, company. Banner: Ask what will still be done.
